description: This file defines a test execution listener class for the SalesManager application, managing entity managers during test execution lifecycle events.

classes.name: SalesManagerCoreTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A custom test execution listener that integrates with Spring testing framework, handling entity manager setup and teardown during test lifecycle.

methods.name: beforeTestClass
methods.description: Invoked before the execution of any test methods in the class; performs dependency injection.

methods.name: beforeTestMethod
methods.description: Executed before each test method; opens an entity manager.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Executed after each test method; closes the entity manager.
